accepted.s: Under the Disaster Management Act, 2005 and the Andhra Pradesh Disaster Management Rules, 2007, which institution functions as the chief nodal agency for disaster management in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Andhra Pradesh State Disaster Management Authority
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh State Disaster Management Authority (APSDMA) is a statutory body under the Disaster Management Act, 2005 and the Andhra Pradesh Disaster Management Rules, 2007, and is the chief nodal agency for disaster management in the State.
accepted.tq: Identify the statutory body from its legal basis and assigned role.
accepted.sec: APSDMA - statutory role, early warning, coordination, IMD Visakhapatnam

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the functions of APSDMA?
o: It deals only with post-disaster relief distribution.
It coordinates district authorities, operates early warning systems and undertakes both pre-disaster planning and post-disaster restoration.
It exclusively regulates irrigation reservoirs in Andhra Pradesh.
It prepares only long-term urban development plans.
accepted.x: APSDMA runs the State Emergency Operations Centre, coordinates district authorities, operates early warning systems, and covers both pre-disaster planning and post-disaster restoration.
accepted.tq: Choose the option containing the complete range of functions rather than an extreme exclusive role.
accepted.sec: APSDMA - statutory role, early warning, coordination, IMD Visakhapatnam

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the IMD Cyclone Warning Centre at Visakhapatnam:
1. It is one of the seven cyclone warning centres in India.
2. The other listed centres include Chennai, Mumbai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Thiruvananthapuram and Bhubaneswar.
3. It is the only cyclone warning centre in India.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam is one of seven listed IMD cyclone warning centres. Statement 3 is false because it is not the only such centre.
accepted.tq: Find the single extreme false statement while checking the complete membership list.
accepted.sec: APSDMA - statutory role, early warning, coordination, IMD Visakhapatnam

accepted.s: The City Flood Alert introduced in Vijayawada in July 2026 was jointly developed by which of the following?
accepted.x: The City Flood Alert was developed through collaboration among RTGS, APSDMA and IIT Gandhinagar.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure institutional pair and eliminate organisations not named in the collaboration.
accepted.sec: APSDMA - statutory role, early warning, coordination, IMD Visakhapatnam

accepted.s:
With reference to the City Flood Alert launched first in Vijayawada, consider the following statements:
1. It provides rainfall forecasts up to 48 hours.
2. It provides flash-flood warnings up to 6 hours.
3. It uses artificial intelligence, satellite-derived digital elevation models and three decades of Budameru flood data.
4. It is intended to be extended to all Urban Local Bodies.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements correctly describe the City Flood Alert: its forecast periods, technological inputs, Budameru data base and proposed extension to all ULBs.
accepted.tq: Use the all-inclusive option when each detailed operational feature is correct.
accepted.sec: APSDMA - statutory role, early warning, coordination, IMD Visakhapatnam

accepted.s: The City Flood Alert introduced in Vijayawada is designed to provide a flash-flood warning for a period of
accepted.x: The system provides flash-flood warnings six hours in advance, besides 48-hour rainfall forecasts.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the short warning horizon from the longer rainfall-forecast horizon.
accepted.sec: APSDMA - statutory role, early warning, coordination, IMD Visakhapatnam

accepted.s: During the July 2026 El Niño review, which operational arrangement was directed for disaster preparedness in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Only district control rooms were to operate, without weather alerts.
Control rooms were to function only during daylight hours.
Control rooms at State and district levels were to function round the clock, with IMD and APSDMA alerts pushed to the field level.
Control rooms were to be replaced by private forecasting agencies.
accepted.x: The direction required round-the-clock control rooms at State and district levels and dissemination of IMD and APSDMA alerts to field-level agencies.
accepted.tq: Apply the operational requirement to a preparedness scenario.
accepted.sec: APSDMA - statutory role, early warning, coordination, IMD Visakhapatnam

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding flood management in India:
1. Flood management is a State subject.
2. The Centre provides technical guidance and promotional funds through the Flood Management and Border Areas Programme.
3. The programme also covers anti-sea-erosion works.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Flood management is a State subject, while the Centre supports States through technical guidance and promotional funding under FMBAP, which also includes anti-sea-erosion works.
accepted.tq: Check both the constitutional responsibility and the supporting central programme.
accepted.sec: Flood forecasting and control - CWC, expert committees, embankments, zoning

accepted.s: Which of the following is a non-structural measure of flood management?
accepted.x: Flood-plain zoning is a non-structural measure. Embankments, flood walls and reservoirs are structural measures.
accepted.tq: Separate physical engineering works from planning, warning and insurance measures.
accepted.sec: Flood forecasting and control - CWC, expert committees, embankments, zoning

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Flood-management measure)
a. Embankments
b. Flood forecasting and warning
c. Detention basins
 d. Flood insurance

List-II (Category)
i. Structural
 ii. Non-structural

accepted.x: Embankments and detention basins are structural measures. Flood forecasting and warning and flood insurance are non-structural measures.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding flood-plain zoning is correct?
o: The Model Flood Plain Zoning Bill was circulated in 1958.
The Model Flood Plain Zoning Bill was circulated in 1975.
The Model Flood Plain Zoning Bill was enacted in 1980 as a Central law.
The Model Flood Plain Zoning Bill was circulated only after 2000.
accepted.x: The Model Flood Plain Zoning Bill was circulated in 1975.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the year of circulation from the year of scientific flood forecasting.
accepted.sec: Flood forecasting and control - CWC, expert committees, embankments, zoning

accepted.s: Urban Flood Risk Management Programme Phase II covers how many cities and is funded in what Centre–State ratio?
accepted.x: Phase II covers 11 cities, including Visakhapatnam, with funding shared in the ratio of 90:10 between the Centre and the State.
accepted.tq: Combine the coverage figure with the funding ratio to avoid selecting a partly correct option.
accepted.sec: Flood forecasting and control - CWC, expert committees, embankments, zoning

accepted.s: Which of the following cities is specifically included in Phase II of the Urban Flood Risk Management Programme?
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam is among the 11 cities covered by Phase II of the Urban Flood Risk Management Programme.
accepted.tq: Use location-based discrimination among Andhra Pradesh urban centres and project sites.
accepted.sec: Flood forecasting and control - CWC, expert committees, embankments, zoning

accepted.s: Under the Manual for Drought Management, 2016, which two are mandatory indicators for drought assessment?
accepted.x: Rainfall deviation and dry spells are the mandatory indicators. Crop sowing, satellite vegetation index, soil moisture and hydrology are impact indicators used to confirm the assessment.
accepted.tq: Separate mandatory indicators from confirmatory impact indicators.
accepted.sec: Drought management - Manual 2016, CDP threshold, CWWG, SC guidelines

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about drought assessment under the Manual for Drought Management, 2016:
1. Crop sowing is an impact indicator.
2. Satellite vegetation index can be used as an impact indicator.
3. Soil moisture and hydrology can help confirm the drought call.
4. Drought is classified as either moderate or severe.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. Rainfall deviation and dry spells trigger the assessment, while the listed impact indicators help confirm whether drought is moderate or severe.
accepted.tq: Distinguish trigger indicators from impact indicators while checking the final classification.
accepted.sec: Drought management - Manual 2016, CDP threshold, CWWG, SC guidelines

accepted.s: The Crop Weather Watch Group, which tracks rainfall, sowing and reservoir conditions during the monsoon, functions under the
o: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
accepted.x: The Crop Weather Watch Group functions under the Ministry of Agriculture and meets weekly during the monsoon.
accepted.tq: Apply the ministry-responsibility trap to distinguish agricultural monitoring from general disaster management.
accepted.sec: Drought management - Manual 2016, CDP threshold, CWWG, SC guidelines

accepted.s: How frequently does the Crop Weather Watch Group meet during the monsoon season?
accepted.x: The Crop Weather Watch Group meets weekly during the monsoon to monitor rainfall, sowing and reservoir conditions.
accepted.tq: Test the precise periodicity rather than the group’s general function.
accepted.sec: Drought management - Manual 2016, CDP threshold, CWWG, SC guidelines

accepted.s: In Swaraj Abhiyan v. Union of India (2016), the Supreme Court directed the updating of the drought manual and the establishment of the
accepted.x: The Supreme Court directed that the drought manual be updated and the National Disaster Mitigation Fund be set up.
accepted.tq: Link the judicial case with the specific institutional outcome ordered by the Court.
accepted.sec: Drought management - Manual 2016, CDP threshold, CWWG, SC guidelines

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the division of responsibility for notified disasters mentioned in the disaster-management framework?
o: The Ministry of Agriculture handles only floods, while the Ministry of Home Affairs handles agricultural drought.
The Ministry of Home Affairs handles only drought, while the Ministry of Agriculture handles all other disasters.
The Ministry of Agriculture handles drought, pest attacks, hailstorms and frost/cold waves, while the Ministry of Home Affairs handles other notified disasters.
Both ministries have identical responsibility for every notified disaster.
accepted.x: The Ministry of Agriculture handles drought along with pest attacks, hailstorms and frost/cold waves. The Ministry of Home Affairs handles other notified disasters.
accepted.tq: Compare ministries by matching each with its specific disaster portfolio.
accepted.sec: Drought management - Manual 2016, CDP threshold, CWWG, SC guidelines

accepted.s: The NADAMS satellite system is associated with the monitoring of
accepted.x: NADAMS is used to monitor agricultural drought through satellite-based assessment.
accepted.tq: Match the named satellite system with its specialised monitoring function.
accepted.sec: Drought management - Manual 2016, CDP threshold, CWWG, SC guidelines

accepted.s:
Which combination represents structural measures recommended for cyclone mitigation under the NDMA Cyclone Guidelines, 2008?
1. Multipurpose cyclone shelters
2. Raised platforms
3. All-weather evacuation roads
4. Storm-surge barriers
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Multipurpose shelters, raised platforms, all-weather evacuation roads and storm-surge barriers are all structural cyclone-mitigation measures identified in the guidelines.
accepted.tq: Group the listed engineering and evacuation facilities under structural mitigation.
accepted.sec: Cyclone mitigation - shelters, roof design, NCRMP

accepted.s: Which of the following is a nature-based cyclone-mitigation measure?
accepted.x: Mangroves and coastal bio-shields are nature-based measures. Saline embankments and sand-dune restoration are also included in this category.
accepted.tq: Distinguish ecosystem-based measures from built infrastructure.
accepted.sec: Cyclone mitigation - shelters, roof design, NCRMP

accepted.s: Which roof design is generally better suited to resist high cyclone winds?
o: A flat roof resting loosely on the walls
A conical roof without wall connections
A hipped roof firmly anchored to the walls
accepted.x: A hipped roof with firm anchoring of the roof to the walls resists high winds better than a gable roof.
accepted.tq: Apply the wind-resistance principle to a building-design situation.
accepted.sec: Cyclone mitigation - shelters, roof design, NCRMP

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the National Cyclone Risk Mitigation Project:
1. Its Phase I was aided by the World Bank.
2. Andhra Pradesh and Odisha were covered under Phase I.
3. It is associated with cyclone shelters and improved forecasting in reducing cyclone deaths.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. NCRMP Phase I was World Bank-aided, covered Andhra Pradesh and Odisha, and formed part of the wider mitigation effort involving shelters and forecasting.
accepted.tq: Verify the project’s funding, geographical coverage and mitigation outcome together.
accepted.sec: Cyclone mitigation - shelters, roof design, NCRMP

accepted.s: The IMD 72-hour cyclone track-forecast error declined during 2013–2022 from 201 km to
accepted.x: The 72-hour track-forecast error decreased from 201 km to 153 km during 2013–2022.
accepted.tq: Separate the 72-hour figures from the similar 24-hour forecast figures.
accepted.sec: Cyclone mitigation - shelters, roof design, NCRMP

accepted.s: The Godavari Anicut associated with Sir Arthur Cotton was constructed during
accepted.x: The Godavari Anicut was built from 1847 to April 1852. It is now known as the Sir Arthur Cotton or Dowleswaram Barrage near Rajamahendravaram.

accepted.x: The Godavari delta was affected by floods, cyclones and famine, prompting construction of the anicut. Historical references include the 1833 cyclone and the 1840 gale.
accepted.tq: Link the engineering project with the environmental hazards it was intended to address.

accepted.s: The present-day name and location of the Godavari Anicut are correctly represented by which of the following?
o: Sir Arthur Cotton (Dowleswaram) Barrage near Rajamahendravaram
accepted.x: The Godavari Anicut is now the Sir Arthur Cotton, or Dowleswaram, Barrage near Rajamahendravaram.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the Godavari project, the Krishna anicut and Polavaram.
